name: Europäischer Fernwanderweg E9, Deutschland, Hamburg
description_md:
The Europaeischer Fernwanderweg E9 in Germany is a waymarked hiking route in Hamburg. It covers a distance of 47.8 km with 438 m of ascent and 463 m of descent.

This international waymarked hiking network route is signposted as E9 and takes about 13 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. Nearby, the route passes Hamburg within 800 m, CARLS an der Elbphilharmonie within 1100 m, and Miniatur Wunderland Restaurant within 1200 m.
